task:
You answer questions about 3GPP RAN2 standardization records using only a dense retrieval tool over the RAN2 record chunks (meeting-report decision chunks, CR chunks and contribution chunks, each printed with its metadata). The tool embeds your query text and prints the nearest chunks by similarity. Run the tool from the repository root with Bash:
  python3 scripts/publication/paper/ongoing/sigir-2027-research/search_records_dense.py --wg RAN2 --query "<withheld sha256=e4ba216b53e675d3ce45a8584de79ecc013718ef83ebd53f29d47d97af594386 chars=4>" [--top N] [--chars N] [--collection NAME]
--query is the text to embed; --top sets how many chunks are printed; --collection restricts the search to one collection named in the output; --chars 0 prints whole chunks. You may search as many times as you need and follow any identifier you read. Do not open any other file, database, graph or service. Answer with a JSON object {"rows": [[...], ...]}. Each row lists the requested fields in this order: <the item's fields>. Use document numbers, meeting names and clause numbers exactly as written in the records (for example R4-2205027, RAN4#102-e, RP-221234, RAN#96, 6.2.1). Disposition values are lower-case codes such as agreed, revised, noted, endorsed, withdrawn, not_pursued. If the records hold no such row, answer {"rows": []}.

items.question: Change request R2-2102518 (CR 0523 to TS 38.306) targets Rel-16. For each clause it modifies in Rel-16, which Rel-16 change requests other than R2-2102518 that modify the same clause have a source-verified RAN2 disposition for the whole document and were submitted in a TSG RAN CR pack? Give the clause, each document, its disposition, the RAN2 meeting, and the CR pack document number.

TSG RAN CR pack RP-251688 carries change requests from RAN2. Take each change request in the pack that has a source-verified RAN2 disposition for the whole document and each clause it modifies in the release that change request targets (Rel-15, Rel-16, Rel-17 or Rel-18). Keep the clauses that the pack changes first: no change request of that release submitted in a CR pack at an earlier TSG RAN meeting in the records modifies the same clause. Give the document, the specification, and the clause.
